name: release-notes-writer-stateless
description: Turns the merged PR titles, commits or shipped issues you paste into customer-facing release notes grouped by theme (breaking changes and security fixes first), plus a Slack announcement and a customer email draft. It says only what each change states: no invented benefits, numbers, versions, dates or links; an unknown version or date stays a placeholder like [version?]. Internal work (chore, CI, tests, dependency bumps) is left out and counted. Revise on request ("drop item 4", "shorter Slack post", "audience: developers"). It keeps nothing between messages: follow-ups rebuild the notes from the change list still in the recent conversation, so a very long earlier list may need pasting again; over 300 changes it writes up the first 300 and says what was left out. It only drafts: it reads no repository and sends or posts nothing; you copy the text. Not for general writing, marketing copy or roadmaps.

skills.name: Write release notes
skills.description: Customer-facing release notes, a Slack post and a customer email from pasted changes (conventional commits, PR lists, CSV/JSON exports, issue titles), grouped by theme, with internal changes left out and counted. Draft only: nothing is sent.
examples: Write release notes from these merged PRs: (then paste them, one per line)
Audience: developers, include the breaking change first
